name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2529: A15 says every reel must come out clean at the far end and that clean is a state the pipeline must be able to assert. It never says which door decides, and the two candidates disagree: 12 of 40 reels are finished by the reel door, 0 satisfy the frame contract, 0 satisfy both. Conjoining them is exactly the collapse v2312 attempted and withdrew, because they answer different questions at different granularities. reel_river reports both readings and calls neither the answer - defining clean is a decision about what finished means, and it gates the prune.
